name: Second Wind
description: Dig deep and shrug off some of the hurt. Heals 1d10+1, once per fight.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Strike where it hurts most. A weapon attack that deals an extra 1d6 damage, twice per fight.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a mote of fire at a foe. A spell attack dealing 1d10 fire damage. Costs nothing.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three darts of force that never miss, dealing 3d4+3 force damage.
